data.name: ShotFightDisaster
data.detailed_description:
ShotFightDisaster wasn’t created because the world needs yet another shooter.

It was created because millions of players love tactical shooters – but at some point stopped enjoying them.

ShotFightDisaster is a response to the problems that classic tactical shooters have developed over many years.

The Vision: Ending the Frustration

For everyone who loves tactical shooters... but lost the fun along the way.

ShotFightDisaster is born from over two decades of firsthand gaming experience. We know the typical frustrations of modern multiplayer games. We’ve experienced it ourselves. Thousands of times: cheaters, smurfs, unfair matches, toxic lobbies, and coordinated full-stacks ruthlessly crushing solo players.

This game was not developed for esports pros. It was built for solo gamers who simply want to experience fair, exciting, and competitive matches after a long day at work.

The Gameplay: Classic Tactics Reimagined

SHOTFIGHT DISASTER is a tactical 4v4 first-person shooter in the style of classic objective-based battles.

  • The Mission: Attackers steal gold, cash, or plant bombs. Defenders must stop them.

  • The Core: Every round relies on precise gunplay, smart positioning, and real communication.

  • The Goal: Every design element serves to give you back control over your match.

The Features: Gameplay Over Gimmicks

  • 🎮 Built for casual gamer
    Whether you play every day or just a few hours a week – we want every single match to be fun. Your enjoyment matters here, not your grind.

  • 🛡️ Developed for Fair Matches
    Our aim is to make matches as fair as possible. Skill, teamwork, and smart decisions are more important at every second than unfair advantages or pay-to-win mechanics.

  • ⚖️ Competition Without the Hassle
    A tactical shooter where exciting decisions take center stage – not the frustration caused by everything around it. Ideal for solo players too.

  • ⚡ Gadgets as Your Second Chance
    Invisibility, teleportation, force fields, or the suicide vest are not just visual gimmicks. They are powerful tools designed to break you out of seemingly hopeless situations and actively counter unfair opponent tactics.

By a Player, For Players

ShotFightDisaster is being developed by a team that includes players with more than 30,000 hours of experience in tactical shooters dating back to 2004. Many of the game's mechanics and design choices are shaped by the real-world experiences of players who have faced and shared the same frustrations as you.

Wishlist

Add ShotFightDisaster to your wish list now and help build a fair alternative for players who love tactical shooters but are fed up with the frustration.

Features:

• Tactical team shooter with strategic gameplay

• Focus on fair matches for regular players

• Anti-cheat systems

• Player abilities for active defence against unfair play

• We offer various game modes (Deathmatch, Equal Chance...)

• Win a round by stealing gold or cash and bringing your loot safely to the safe zone.

• Win a round by successfully carrying out an attack.

• Win a round by eliminating all opponents.

• Take on bots offline or play online in multiplayer mode (Deathmatch, Equal Opportunity...)

data.short_description: Are tactical shooters just frustrating you with cheaters, smurfs and unfair matches? ShotFightDisaster brings the fun back! A tactical 4v4 multiplayer shooter developed by players for players – without the usual frustration, but with fair matches and powerful gadgets for everyday gamers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 20H1
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700K CPU @ 4.20GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 (comparable or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 - 25H2
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
